messages:
maria: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — the ETL lag on 3/12 caused delayed spans and a couple bad aggregations in analytics. We need clear owners and short timelines for the fixes and monitoring so this doesn't recur. I'll list suggested items, please claim and add ETA.

ajay: I can own the detection + dashboard work. Will add a live metric for ETL processing latency and a rolling count of missing-span errors. ETA EOD tomorrow.

dave: I'll take the pipeline remediation — looks like the backfill window logic regressed after the reorder PR. Plan: revert the reorder in staging, add integration test for edge-case ordering, and run a targeted backfill for the 12–14th window. ETA Wed COB.

sasha: I will own alerts + regression tests. I'll add a Prometheus alert for median ETL latency > 120s for 5m and a synthetic job that validates span counts after each deploy. Putting a gating check in CI for the integration test Dave mentioned. ETA Tue morning.

observability-bot: Incident summary posted: <https://redwood.internal/pms/ETL-2026-03-12>. 3 alerts fired, highest impact: span-drop-rate spike x3.

maria: thanks. Add the PR numbers and a quick runbook entry for oncall to triage span-drop spikes. We should also identify recurring pattern: seems every 6–8 weeks after a deploy that touches ordering.

ajay: Added dashboard PR: https://git.redwood/infr/mon/pulls/412 and query snippet in PR description. Quick query to surface problematic batches:
```sql
SELECT batch_id, avg(processing_ms) as avg_ms, sum(missing_spans)
FROM etl_metrics
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY batch_id
HAVING avg(processing_ms) > 120000 OR sum(missing_spans) > 0
ORDER BY avg_ms DESC
```

dave: Backfill PR: https://git.redwood/etl/pulls/389. The staging revert is at https://git.redwood/etl/commits/fe12a. I flagged the reorder change that caused the windowing gap.

sasha: CI gating PR: https://git.redwood/ci/pulls/77 — adds synthetic run and a postdeploy validation step. Also added alert doc with runbook snippet: "If span-drop spike -> pause deploys, trigger pipeline backfill job id, notify #incidents and oncall".

maria: Ownership recap in thread so we have one place: Ajay (detection/dashboard) by EOD tomorrow; Dave (pipeline fix + backfill) Wed COB; Sasha (alerts + CI gating) Tue morning. Ops: add runbook + link to postmortem.

ajay: Also adding a metric: unique_service_span_ratio per deploy. Will add it to the canary dashboard so future ordering changes show impact quickly.

dave: For tracking, I've created a lightweight checklist in the postmortem doc: https://redwood.docs/pm/etl-2026-03-12/followups and added items with owners and due dates.

maria: Cool. Let's do a quick 15m sync tomorrow 10:30 to confirm progress; I'll schedule. If anyone hits a blocker ping me and @sasha for CI or @ajay for visibility.

sasha: ack. I'll also add a weekly regression query alert that runs for 8 weeks to detect recurring pattern — if we see 2 recurrences we escalate to a broader rollout freeze policy.

ajay: One more: I'll add a low-noise anomaly detector to reduce false positives from normal load spikes.

maria: Thanks everyone. We'll close out when dashboards, PRs merged, backfill completes, and runbook is in place. I'll post a final signoff here. :white_check_mark:
